product_metadata.title: DFACKTO Interceptor 10 Inch Butcher Knife for Camping and Outdoor Kitchen, Stonewashed High Carbon Stainless Steel Black Knife, Full Tang Tactical G10 Handle, BBQ Utensil Cutlery
features: RUGGED. DEPENDABLE. KNIVES.: With uncompromising looks and an aggressive feel, DFACKTO 10” Butcher Knife is as assertive as it is effective with precision balance and exceptional design. It’s built tough to handle extreme conditions wherever you roam.

UNCOMPROMISINGLY FUNCTIONAL: A tactical grip supercharges a curved 10” high carbon stainless steel full tang blade to rip into cuts of meat, large fish or poultry with surgical control and ease in wet, slippery conditions. It’s a great culinary tool to have handy in the kitchen or outdoors with a devastatingly sharp 20° hand finished edge. Designed to fit secure and comfortably in large and small hands.

STRIKING DESIGN, EXTREME DURABILITY: A full-tang blade securely meets a Mil Spec G10 fiber-resin handles that is impervious to wet, hot and cold conditions. The tactical grip provides a superior anti-slip surface that comfortably fits large and small hands securely regardless of grip style and comes protected with a custom fitted thermoplastic sheath.

SUPERB PERFORMANCE AND EDGE RETENTION: 57+- HRC high-carbon 5Cr15Mov stainless steel blades come razor sharp and will hold will their edge. Imposing style, rugged functionality, a statement about who you are on your culinary journey. The blade is acid stonewashed to a matte finish providing superior corrosion and rust resistance, a lower maintenance blade, and a natural appearance that will not scratch off or chip like mediocre coated blades.

SATISFACTION GUARANTEE: Imposing style, rugged functionality, and ready to make a statement about who you are on your next culinary adventure. Try your new DFACKTO knife risk free. LIFETIME WARRANTY against defects. Your knife will arrive securely in a giftbox to ensure safe shipping and making it a great gift for cooks and outdoorsman.
